verdict.rationale: USCIS documents paper filing as an alternative to online filing and names the specific forms for paying fees by mail (G-1450 for card payments, G-1650 for bank-account payments). The pack does not show the exact mailing addresses, lockbox details, or fax numbers needed to complete the task without the online flow. Missing for 10: published exact mailing addresses or lockbox locations, fax numbers or a statement that fax isn't used, an end-to-end mail-filing instructions page, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, a paper, fax, or mail fallback rail is published with the exact addresses, numbers, and forms, so the task can still be completed when the online flow is unavailable

citations.quote: When filing by mail, you can pay using a credit, debit, or prepaid card by completing Form G-1450
Filing a form online is easier and faster than paper filing.
